The submitted answer is **incorrect in part (1)** and correct in part (2).

**(1)** The decisive step is counting all qualifying ordered draws. The unordered type pairs are \(R_1,B_2\) and \(R_2,B_1\), and **each can occur in either order**. Thus
\[
P=2\left(\frac29\frac29+\frac49\frac19\right)
=\boxed{\frac{16}{81}}.
\]
The exact contradiction is that the submitted calculation omits \(B_2\) followed by \(R_1\) and \(R_2\) followed by \(B_1\). These contribute another \(8/81\).

**(2)** Independently,
\[
P(A)=\frac69=\boxed{\frac23},\qquad
P(B)=\frac39=\boxed{\frac13}.
\]
Checking independence:
\[
P(A\cap B)
=\frac29\frac28+\frac49\frac38
=\frac29
=P(A)P(B).
\]
Therefore, \(\boxed{A\text{ and }B\text{ are independent}}\), as submitted.
